show.description: In Billionaire Ki Legacy, Meri Kokh Se Shuru Hui, the fate of the powerful Mehta Empire rests on unexpected shoulders. Anaya, a simple yet determined woman, finds herself entangled in the lives of Samar Mehta, the heir to a vast fortune, Kabir, her past love with disruptive ambitions, and Sonia, the cunning rival who will stop at nothing for power. As secrets, betrayal, and love collide, Anaya’s womb becomes the beginning of a legacy that could redefine the empire’s future. Watch Now!
